summary: Executed non-destructive backend + frontend verification for supplier-assessment STATUS documents, targeted supplier visibility, GHG submission snapshot routes, ESG lock behavior contracts, and admin aggregation UI rendering.
action_items: Add seeded fixtures (at least one submitted STATUS response, one in-progress ESG draft, and one unassigned selected-supplier document) to eliminate data-dependent skips and fully prove lock/access scenarios every run.
Optionally strengthen parent-GHG regression with seeded drafts+submission to assert strict exclusion of raw drafts from /api/supplier-assessment/emissions/all deterministically.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/modules/supplier_assessment/router.py remains very large (~1000 lines), increasing regression risk for frequent supplier-assessment changes.
backend/modules/supplier_assessment/service.py uses a fallback hardcoded FRONTEND_URL default in email-link construction; this weakens fail-fast environment-only configuration discipline.

success_rate.backend: 100% pass on executed tests (2/2); 3 tests skipped due missing live seed states

seed_data_creation: None (intentionally avoided mutations: no uploads, no GHG submit, no questionnaire submit, no response edits).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Supplier UI pages rendered and were accessible; supplier had zero assigned document cards in this dataset during test. Admin Documents page showed 'Response Type' label and select-all supplier control. Backend live suite passed core non-destructive checks but skipped three scenarios because current data lacked required states (submitted STATUS response, in-progress ESG draft, and unassigned selected-document case).
rca of the issue: No runtime failures reproduced in executed paths. Remaining gaps are data-state dependent coverage gaps: certain lock/visibility checks require pre-existing submitted/in-progress records that were absent in this live dataset, causing controlled skips rather than false-positive mutations.
